INSTANTPILL-CAPSULE.title: Capsule
INSTANTPILL-CAPSULE.description: Capsules enter your hand at the start of combat, are retained at the end of your turn, and are removed from your deck when played.
INSTANTPILL-MYSTERY.description: This capsule's effect has not been revealed.
INSTANTPILL-STATUS_CARD.title: Status
INSTANTPILL-STATUS_CARD.description: Status cards usually have harmful effects when played or drawn.
